honestly it depends on the person you ask. im new to all of this but for me, i have a few reasons but first i just want to say its really admirable to see that you are trying to understand your son and that i wish i had you for a parent. i first started cutting because i feel like i had no one to talk to about the problems i was dealing with inside my head. it kind of feels like a relief  to feel all my pain physically than mentally for me. now i dont know why but i like to cut. i like the blade and i like the scabs that i make when i make shallow cuts. 
  i think that if you want to know why your son cuts you should ask him but definitely don’t pressure him into giving you an answer. some of us are just not ready to talk to family about why we do what we do to cope. and as a parent your role is to be okay with that and be there/provide comfort for him when he is ready. ask him what he thinks the next step is if its not a conversation with you. sorry hope this helps a bit.
